# DSC Hex: Beta Test Plan

The use cases a real person should walk through on the deployed site before the 9 October Kickoff, grouped by who does them. Each one says what to do and what should happen.

**Accounts and passwords** are in `beta/BETA_ACCOUNTS.local.md` (gitignored, never commit it). It is generated by `scripts/create-beta-accounts.ts`. The cast is one squad on brief 1 (Masaraat Learning):

| Account | Role |
|---|---|
| Your own founder account | Founder |
| `beta-ops` | Operations |
| `beta-cluster-lead` | Mentor, Cluster Lead of the beta cluster |
| `beta-client-mentor` | Mentor, Client Mentor of the beta cluster (plays Nadia Younes) |
| `beta-track-mentor` | Mentor, Track Mentor, AI & Deep Tech |
| `beta-lead` | Intern, team lead, SWE pod |
| `beta-deputy` | Intern, deputy lead, AI pod |
| `beta-member-swe`, `beta-member-ai` | Interns, squad members |
| `beta-observer` | Intern with status Observer, no squad |

Every beta document carries `beta: true`. The roster generator ignores beta data, so this squad never mixes into the real cohort.

## Legend

- **AUTO**: also checked by a script against the local emulator (`npm run beta:smoke`, last run 30/30 passed). The script proves the rules and server logic; the beta still has to prove the screens.
- **MANUAL**: only a person can check it (UI, voice, email, real networks).

---

## 0. Before the beta starts (one-time setup)

| # | Step | Command / where |
|---|---|---|
| 0.1 | Deploy the Firestore rules to the production database (first done 2026-10-03 04:49 UTC; **again now**, for Hexa, notifications and the track lock). Dry run first; it lists every removed line. | `npx tsx scripts/deploy-rules.ts` then `npx tsx scripts/deploy-rules.ts --deploy` |
| 0.2 | **Done 2026-10-03.** Create the beta accounts in production (re-run to reset passwords). | `npx tsx scripts/create-beta-accounts.ts --production` |
| 0.3 | **Done 2026-10-03.** Load the brief documents into production (re-run after real clusters exist, to load their roleplay scripts). | `npx tsx scripts/load-problem-statements.ts --write --production` |
| 0.4 | Vercel environment variables: `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `FILE_SEARCH_STORE_NAME`, `GITHUB_TOKEN` (fine-grained, public repos, read-only), `CRON_SECRET` (any long random string; Vercel sends it to the Friday digest job). Redeploy after adding. | Vercel, Settings, Environment Variables |
| 0.5 | Optional: grant "Monitoring Viewer" to `firebase-adminsdk-fbsvc@gen-lang-client-0420599640.iam.gserviceaccount.com` so the Ops quota view shows Google's real numbers. | Google Cloud Console, IAM |
| 0.6 | After the beta: delete everything beta. | `npx tsx scripts/create-beta-accounts.ts --production --delete` |

The name in the header and sidebar is the account's own, never "Jane Doe" or "Alex Mercer". | AUTO (sign-in) + MANUAL (landing page, name) |

| O12 | Audit Log page | Lists every gate operation from this test, newest first | MANUAL |

## 4. AI Weekly Sync, team lead and deputy

| # | Use case | Expected | Check |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | As `beta-member-swe`, open AI Weekly Sync | "Only the team lead or deputy lead runs the sync." Calling the endpoint directly is refused. | AUTO |
| S2 | As the Observer | Same as S1 | AUTO |
| S3 | As `beta-lead`, set the squad repository (any public GitHub repo, e.g. `https://github.com/vitejs/vite`) | Saves. A non-GitHub address is refused. A plain member cannot set it. | AUTO + MANUAL |
| S4 | As `beta-lead`, start the voice sync alone | Microphone prompt, then the assistant speaks. It asks which squad and sprint and what you committed to last week; it does not invent last week. Timer runs; a countdown appears from 7:00. | AUTO (token) + MANUAL (voice) |
| S5 | During S4, talk | Your words and the assistant's appear in the transcript **as they are spoken**, then settle when the turn ends | MANUAL |
| S6 | During S4, with a repo set | At some point the assistant asks about a real pull request from that repo (an old unreviewed one, or something closed without merging). It asks; it never grades anyone. | AUTO (text version) + MANUAL (voice) |
| S7 | Press Mute, keep talking | The assistant stops hearing you | MANUAL |
| S8 | End the sync | Review screen: an editable summary, what was recorded (progress, shipped, blockers, commitments, mood), and any risk flags in plain words | AUTO + MANUAL |
| S9 | Before publishing, sign in as `beta-cluster-lead` | The summary is not visible to the Cluster Lead yet | AUTO |
| S10 | Publish as the lead, then check as the Cluster Lead | Now visible. The raw transcript is still never visible to the Cluster Lead or to squad members. | AUTO |
| S11 | Two computers, `beta-lead` ticks "Bring ... onto the call" and opens the call | Waiting room shows the lead "Here" and the deputy "Waiting to join". No timer yet. | AUTO (rules) + MANUAL |
| S12 | `beta-deputy` opens AI Weekly Sync | An invitation card; "Join the call" | MANUAL |
| S13 | Deputy joins | Both hear each other, then the assistant. Both see the same live transcript and the same timer. A "Lead and deputy" badge shows. | MANUAL (proven on one machine, **not yet across two networks**) |
| S14 | Lead ends the call | The deputy sees "The sync has ended". The lead gets the review screen. | MANUAL |
| S15 | Lead opens the call, deputy never comes | "Start without your deputy" starts a normal solo sync | MANUAL |
| S16 | Deputy on a different network (e.g. phone hotspot vs home Wi-Fi) | Connects. If it says the browsers could not reach each other, note the two networks: this is the case a TURN relay fixes. | MANUAL, **the most important unknown** |
| S17 | Deny the microphone | A clear message to allow it; no blank screen | MANUAL |
| S18 | Text sync (after O6 force-fallback, or "File the text sync") | The assistant walks the six segments one question at a time, in English or Arabic matching you | AUTO + MANUAL |
| S19 | Let a voice sync run to 9:00 | It ends itself and the review screen has the whole conversation, not an empty transcript | MANUAL (bug fixed, not watched to 9:00 in a browser) |
| S20 | Each sync started | Appears in Ops' "Measured by Hex" counts | AUTO |

## 7. Hexa, the AI mentor

Use the beta squad: Mahmoud (lead, SWE pod), Ahmed (deputy, AI pod), Sara (SWE pod), Youssef (AI pod). Mentors: Mona (SWE Track Mentor), Karim (AI Track Mentor), Hany (Cluster Lead), Dalia (Client Mentor).

| # | Use case | Expected | Check |
|---|---|---|---|
| X1 | Sara: Meet Hexa, book a one-to-one, join when it opens, talk for real | Hexa greets her by name, asks about her work, speaks Arabic if she does. 2nd one-to-one the same week refused | AUTO (H2-H6) + MANUAL voice |
| X2 | Ask Hexa something hard ("how do I design auth for millions of users?") | It does not bluff: says the time will not allow it and it is noting it for her Track Mentor | MANUAL |

| X5 | Mahmoud books the SWE pod meeting; Mahmoud and Sara join from **two different networks** | Waiting room, then the call starts by itself when both connect; both hear Hexa and each other; Hexa goes round by name | AUTO (same network) + **MANUAL, two networks** |
| X6 | Mahmoud books the pitch rehearsal; he joins first from a laptop, the squad joins, he presses Share slides and pitches | Hexa sets up, listens without interrupting, then asks client questions that name specific slides (a number on a slide, a slide's claim); feedback appears for the whole squad and Hany | AUTO (H15-H20, slide frames reach Gemini) + MANUAL |
| X6b | Share slides on a phone | The button is not offered; a note says sharing needs a laptop; Hexa coaches the spoken pitch | MANUAL |
| X7 | Sara tries to book the pitch | The option is disabled ("your lead or deputy books it") | AUTO (role check) |
| X8 | Youssef: Client interview practice | Hexa says it is a made-up client, answers only what is asked; feedback lists what he uncovered and missed; only Youssef sees it | AUTO (H16, H18, H21) + MANUAL |

## 8. Navigation, layout and devices

Every role now has its own menu (src/lib/navigation.ts). Nothing on any page is sample data.

| # | Use case | Expected | Check |
|---|---|---|---|
| N1 | Sara (member): the menu | Home, My squad, Client, Meet Hexa, Curriculum. No Weekly sync, no Hexa reports, no grades or tasks page | AUTO (navigation tests, role-layout check) |
| N2 | Mahmoud (lead) and Ahmed (deputy) | The same plus Weekly sync | AUTO |
| N3 | Laila (Observer) | Home, Client, Meet Hexa, Curriculum. No My squad. Home explains what an Observer can still do | AUTO |
| N4 | Mona (Track Mentor) / Hany (Cluster Lead) / Dalia (Client Mentor) | Home, My squads, Hexa reports (Mona and Hany only), Clients. Home lists only what needs that role | AUTO |
| N5 | Nour (Ops) | Overview, People, Squads, Clients, Hexa reports, AI controls, Knowledge base, Audit log. Overview's "Needs attention" flags the beta squad's thin pods | AUTO + MANUAL |
| N6 | My squad (intern) and My squads > a squad (mentor) | Members by sub-pod with Lead/Deputy badges, who supports the squad; the squad repo link if set | MANUAL |
| N7 | Client page | Two tabs: the brief and all companies. Interns see their own brief only after the Kickoff reveal | MANUAL |
| N8 | On a real phone (iPhone and Android) | Open every page from the menu: nothing scrolls sideways, text is readable without zooming, the H chat button does not hide a button you need | AUTO (WebKit and Chromium device profiles) + **MANUAL on real phones** |
| N9 | On a tablet and a laptop | Same pages; two-column layouts appear from tablet landscape up | AUTO + MANUAL |
| N10 | Dark mode (theme button in the top bar) | Every page readable in dark; no white panels | MANUAL |
| N11 | Notifications bell | Unread count; each notification opens where it belongs (a mentor's report, an intern's Meet Hexa); Mark all read | MANUAL |
| N12 | Ops: Knowledge base | Upload a .md file and delete it again from the live site; the chat answers from it within a minute | MANUAL |
| N13 | The platform tour (menu > Platform tour) | Describes only what exists for that role | MANUAL |

Automated checks, run locally against the emulator: `node scripts/ui/role-layout-check.mjs` (every page per role at 390, 768, 1024, 1280 and 1440) and `node scripts/ui/cross-browser-check.cjs` (Safari, Chrome and Firefox on phone, tablet and desktop profiles).

## Reporting a problem

For anything that fails, note: the use case number, which account, phone or computer, the browser, what you expected, what happened, and a screenshot. If a page shows an error message, copy it exactly.
